item.title: Russia backs India's claim to UNSC seat, firmly shuts door on Germany & Japan
item.description: At the recent General Assembly, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov reaffirmed Russia's support for India and Brazil to secure permanent membership on the UN Security Council. He criticized the prospect of additional seats for Western countries like Germany and Japan, linking it to the West's military actions in Ukraine, which he argues undermine core principles of the UN.

item.title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
item.description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.

item.title: Dale Earnhardt Jr.'s estate hides 75+ wrecked race cars and Wild West town
item.description: Dale Earnhardt Jr. has more than 75 wrecked race cars scattered across his North Carolina estate. The collection began with damaged JR Motorsports cars and later expanded to vehicles linked to notable NASCAR moments. Known as the “Racecar Graveyard”, it became so large that Earnhardt once spent about a year trying to find one of the cars on his own property.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: California buried 662,700 tires under I-880 ramp, saved $477K, 22 years
item.description: Engineers faced challenges while upgrading a highway interchange in Milpitas due to unstable bay mud. They opted to use shredded waste tires as lightweight fill to prevent ground settlement. This choice reduced weight on the soft soil by 40 percent and saved significant project costs. Over two decades, the infrastructure has shown no maintenance issues or structural damage.
item.dc:creator: TOI WORLD DESK

item.title: US immigration authority has a 10-day deadline on home address
item.description: USCIS has issued a reminder for immigrants to report changes of address within 10 days of moving. Failing to do so may result in missed notices and delays in immigration cases. Changing addresses with the USPS does not automatically update records with USCIS. Immigrants are encouraged to use the online self-service change-of-address tool for a timely update. Paper forms can be submitted, but online updates are recommended for efficiency.

item.title: Clooney and Gerbers' side-by-side Casamigos villas sold for $100M
item.description: Nestled along the serene coast of Mexico, George Clooney, Cindy Crawford, and Rande Gerber crafted two stunning villas, known as Casamigos, which prioritize comfort and seclusion. Designed to accommodate their diverse lifestyles, these luxurious properties fostered memorable family gatherings. Ultimately, they sold the prized villas to a Mexican billionaire for an astonishing $100 million, solidifying its place in the annals of celebrity real estate.

item.title: ‘Damage control’ after EC row: Congress demands SIR rollback, CEC’s resignation
item.description: Congress has called for the suspension of the ongoing Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar. The Election Commission defended its decisions amidst concerns of disenfranchisement of voters and internal disagreements. Congress leaders accused the Commission of inadequately addressing issues with Form 6 changes related to voter registration. They raised questions about deletions of young and Gen Z voters and emphasized the need for transparency.

item.title: Asian Games: India bags 7 medals with kabaddi double; tally climbs to 30
item.description: At the Asian Games 2026, India marked a notable achievement by gathering seven medals on Saturday. The kabaddi squads were outstanding, with men and women conquering Iran to uphold their golds. Sawan Barwal made headlines, winning silver in the men’s marathon, signaling an end to India’s medal dry spell. Silver medals in shooting and a bronze in athletics from Prachi Choudhary highlighted a promising day across various sports.

item.title: Gauhati University student found dead at homestay; boyfriend detained
item.description: The lifeless body of 21-year-old Nimisha Thakuria, a Sociology student at Gauhati University, was discovered at a homestay in Garal-Dharapur. Just before her phone was switched off, she called her mother to express fears of an assault. This incident has sparked protests, with demonstrators raising concerns regarding 'love jihad'. Authorities have named Ashiq Ali as a suspect, who claims she took her own life.
item.dc:creator: TNN

item.title: After 'big talk' with Xi on 'Super Intelligence', Trump shuts door on joint AI push
item.description: Donald Trump and Xi Jinping recently convened to explore the concept of super intelligence, albeit ruling out collaborative AI efforts. Trump asserted that the US is at the forefront of AI development, striving to sustain its competitive edge. They both recognized the significance of the term super intelligence in discussions of emerging technologies and initiated a bilateral communication line for super intelligence-related incidents, planning their next conversation for November 2026.

item.title: 'No answer for Gen Z voters': Cong attacks EC's press note, seeks SIR pause
item.description: Congress has responded to the Election Commission regarding its recent press note and the Special Intensive Revision process. Jairam Ramesh raised several points questioning the credibility and intent of the Election Commission. Allegations of targeting Gen Z voters and the deletion of names from electoral rolls remain unaddressed. The party is calling for immediate suspension of the revision process and accountability for the Chief Election Commissioner.

item.title: 'Khali pet gold jita hai': Why India's kabaddi team did not eat before final
item.description: With 10 minutes left, India moved five points ahead after Arjun got past Iran captain Fazel Atrachali and helped India inflict an All-Out. Sumit then made an important tackle on Amirmohammad Zafar Danesh, while Rahul Sethpal also made a key defensive contribution late in the match. The win completed India's unbeaten campaign and gave them their ninth Asian Games gold medal in men's kabaddi.

item.title: Woman lawyer from Assam assaulted in Delhi's Prasad Nagar
item.description: A lawyer from Assam was reportedly attacked in Delhi amid a property dispute on Friday. Eyewitness accounts reveal that police were on-site as the confrontation unfolded, with a distressing video capturing her distress. The attackers expressed concerns about her being in Delhi due to the ongoing legal matter. In response, both parties have lodged mutual complaints, prompting several FIRs as police delve deeper into this assault and property dispute.
